title: Implement CHECK command handler in transit daemon
description: CHECK (RFC 4644) allows a feeding peer to ask whether the transit daemon wants a specific article (by Message-ID) before sending it. The daemon replies 238 (send it), 431 (try later), or 438 (don't want it). This eliminates the send-then-reject round-trip of IHAVE for articles the server already has. Artifact: CHECK handler in usenet-ipfs-transit, consulting the Message-ID→CID map.
